name: Diamond Allotrope Crystal Lattice
semanticDescription: NCERT Class 10 Chemistry Ch 4 Fig 4.7(a) 3D tetrahedral covalent network crystal lattice of diamond. Each carbon atom is covalently bonded to four other carbon atoms in a rigid tetrahedral framework with sp3 hybridization, bond angle 109.5°, and bond length 1.54 Å. Dual presentation collections: 'Diamond_Lattice_Full' (repeating crystallographic cubic block of interlocking adamantane-like cages mounted on a dark studio slate plinth) and 'Diamond_Lattice_Detail' (isolated single tetrahedral unit with central carbon, 4 covalent bonds, 109.5° bond angle arc, shared valence electron pairs 2e-, 1.54 Å bond caliper, and educational property plaque).
simplifications: Crystallographic block displays Fd-3m diamond cubic symmetry with 29 carbon atoms and 40 covalent bonds.
Bonds shown as sturdy cylindrical rods with metallic luster to clearly visualize the 3D connectivity.
Detail view includes 109.5° bond angle measurement arc and shared valence electron pairs.

Rigid tetrahedral covalent network connector with silvery metallic sheen
Warm amber 109.5° tetrahedral angle indicator arc
Dark studio slate display pedestal with metallic trim footing
